# Workflows
| File | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `check.banners.yaml` | Banner and shelf check on every push and PR, the required `banners` check of `main`. |
| `check.examples.yaml` | Installs every tool and validates the example files on every push and PR. |
| `release.yaml` | Tags and publishes the version from `plugin.json` on every push to `main`. |
